mentions.name: Tuumik
mentions.description: A self-hosted time tracking and in/out board app for teams, built for remote work environments and initially aimed at law firms.
mentions.audience: Initially targeted at law firms; suitable for any team working remotely.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Tuumik - self hosted time tracking and in/out board. The project initially targeted law firms specifically (I was an attorney for a decade before coming back to software development). But Tuumik is suitable for any team working remotely.
